Harness-Work-Orders: WO-HAG-001, WO-HAG-003, WO-HAG-004

## Current review update — verification pending

WO-HAG-003 corrects decision attribution: the actual human remains the
decision-maker, while an optional `--authority-owner` identifies the existing
owner label used. Invalid claims still refuse. The existing holder rules,
atomic writer, paired-risk controls and caller consent boundary remain intact.

The correction is implemented. [VREC-HAG-002](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/verification-records/VREC-HAG-002.md)
is **ready**, bound to candidate `5355877faecf4039c3bf994f43ddc60fef922c50`. Review head: `65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75`.
Human verification is pending. Tested/package source:
`99a8c53f6a2e253c20737d5985223ea0c25c79d9`; later commits add only governance
and retained evidence, with unchanged source/build tree identities.

- [Requirement assessment](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-003/verification-results.json): all eight VER-HAG-003 cases pass.
- [Implementation review](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-003/implementation-review.md).
- [Raw commands, failures and successful reruns](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-003/commands.zip).
- [Equal pinned builds](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-003/build-replay.json).
- Full source suite: 1,305 tests, 22 reported skips, exit 0. Installed-wheel
  probes pass on Windows and Linux (14 CLI observations each); distribution
  and CLI checks pass. Released 0.22.0 validation: zero errors, 61 existing warnings.
- [Approved work](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/work-orders/WO-HAG-003.md) and
  [verification contract](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/verification/VER-HAG-003.md).

Independent WO-HAG-001 work adds strict canonical parsing and immutable
revision/baseline values under its approved scope. [Continuation evidence](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/continuation-20261004/continuation.json)
records that work. **Zero hosted service scenarios have run.**
WO-HAG-001 remains `in_progress`; no hosted verification is claimed.

DEC-HAG-001 remains open. The user's `extend-evaluator` choice is unchanged.
Both evaluator corrections must be released and explicitly adopted before
the live decision and dependent draft adapter can proceed. SPEC-HAG-003 still
pins 0.22.0. Historical VREC-HAG-001 and all its evidence remain unchanged.

This PR remains a draft against `codex/hosted-artifact-graph-inputs` at
`be1812e7042081014cc7682da8b9cd3822d9071f`. It does not target main.
The existing aggregate `docs/engineering/README.md` scope issue against main
remains unresolved. A passing correction check does not clear that issue or
the hosted decision gate. The retained prior handoff below remains historical.

## Transport scope and publication authority

WO-HAG-004 is implemented and covers the five unchanged approved governing
files omitted from the original PR scope. It adds no implementation or new
verification claim. [Transport evidence](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-004/transport-results.json)
records complete-byte equality with the reviewed versions.

mmzen explicitly approved this scope correction and authorized updating this
draft PR, including a later push of the separately given VREC-HAG-002 decision.
This authorization does not accept verification, resolve DEC-HAG-001, authorize
merge, or release an evaluator. The PR stays draft while WO-HAG-001 is unfinished.

## Current check findings

The original-target union check passes path coverage and preflight, then
refuses the unfinished WO-HAG-001 handoff with two predicates:

- `QGP-G4I-EVIDENCE`: its historical handoff packet is bound to the earlier
  snapshot. A released rebind in a disposable clone removes this finding;
  the publication branch preserves that historical packet unchanged.
- `QGP-G4I-DECISION`: DEC-HAG-001 remains open pending qualified evaluator
  release and explicit adoption/amendment. The human choice is already known.

[Publication assessment](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/65a4cc958d27062c3b27b060e9eb5e2f198b2c75/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-004/publication-readiness.json)
retains both findings and the disposable-clone diagnostic. Neither gate is
waived. VREC-HAG-002's separate assurance and review-publication gates pass.
CI for this new review head is pending at publication; the historical CI
failure is not a result for this new head. This is an unfinished draft review.

## Historical Phase 1 handoff

## Summary

Complete the independent Phase 1 contract package for the Hosted Artifact Graph: explicit domain/Cypher reads, accepted receipts and refusals, retry and error ordering, reference context, and expected outcomes for all twelve VER-HAG-001 scenarios. This is a draft continuation/handoff PR; WO-HAG-001 remains `in_progress`, and the hosted service has not been implemented or qualified.

Target: `codex/hosted-artifact-graph-inputs` at `be1812e7042081014cc7682da8b9cd3822d9071f`, which already contains the approved HAG artifacts and the evaluator correction merged in #534. The PR head includes that full history. Its new diff is the Phase 1 continuation; the complete artifact inventory below includes prerequisites inherited from the base. Contract/evidence checkpoint: `9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e`.

This PR does not target `main`. Main remains at original reference commit `82f5a0ed7438a73da8f03aee23ad02a9b8cc09e1`. A previous aggregate check against main found `docs/engineering/README.md` outside the selected work orders' execution scopes. Preserve that integration issue for a scoped assessment; do not retarget or advance a comparison base merely to omit it.

Published handoff head: `7b3a1e8cefc02903f79392ea164aa7d7b8af71f8`, including the [retained handoff packet](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/7b3a1e8cefc02903f79392ea164aa7d7b8af71f8/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/WO-HAG-001-handoff.md). The immutable contract and artifact links below identify the preceding Phase 1 checkpoint; those bytes are unchanged at this head.

## Start here for the receiving Codex agent

1. Fetch and check out `codex/hosted-artifact-phase1` with its history. All formal artifacts, contract fixtures, implementation source and retained verification evidence are in the branch; no earlier chat or scratch script is needed to understand the handoff.
2. Read [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/AGENTS.md), the [domain index](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/README.md), [WO-HAG-001](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/work-orders/WO-HAG-001.md), [protocol guide](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/notes/hosted-artifact-graph.md), and [Phase 1 continuation report](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/phase1-continuation.json).
3. Use Verity Plane setup to select the checkout's separately installed **released evaluator 0.22.0**. Resolve its absolute Python path and run it with `-I -m se_harness` from outside the checkout. The required archive SHA-256 is `44543f242ed19bb30cfd65da415372a87508a6e439204d7f3e37f9f45aefe4e4`; payload SHA-256 is `b4464e0c55814ee62a6e844d712503188493dacf841aeac90d5f270e8c6836c9`. Candidate source is not the repository governor.
4. Obtain fresh `check REPO --artifact WO-HAG-001 --json`, then follow its selected instructions and reading manifest. Existing work is in progress; do not replay approval/start or mark the full work implemented from these contract checks. The current typed step is `STEP-WO-IMPLEMENT-CHECK`; its handoff check still needs the complete implementation and evidence.
5. Resolve the specific admission dependencies below before implementing the dependent draft adapter. Phase 2 then supplies service packaging/lock/image/Compose, schema/init/import, immutable storage, evaluator projection, guarded transactions, domain/MCP/Cypher reads, remote CLI/plugin guidance, and every packaged/recovery scenario in VER-HAG-001.

## Contracts, fixtures and retained evidence

- [Canonical revisions, source manifests, baselines and mutation schema](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/server/contracts/remote-v1.json), [read schema](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/server/contracts/read-v1.json), [receipt/refusal schema](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/server/contracts/result-v1.json), and [proposed physical schema](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/server/contracts/graph-v1.cypher).
- [Independent fixed byte/hash vectors](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/tests/hosted_artifact_graph/fixtures/canonical-v1.json), [complete 1,909-artifact source manifest](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/tests/hosted_artifact_graph/fixtures/reference-manifest.json), and [twelve scenario expectations plus exact reference context](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/tests/hosted_artifact_graph/fixtures/scenarios-v1.json).
- [Phase 0 contract/environment and original Phase 1 observations](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/phase0-contract-result.json), [environment identities](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/phase0-environment.json), [original contract result](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/phase1-contract.json), and [released-evaluator feasibility gap](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/phase1-evaluator-feasibility.json).
- [Latest Phase 1 report](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/phase1-continuation.json) and [actual command outputs](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/phase1-continuation-observations.json).
- [Evaluator correction assessment](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-002/verification-results.json), [raw observations](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-002/raw-observations.zip), and [identical independent build replay](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-002/correction-final-build-replay.json).

## Current publication/readiness blocker

The released PR check currently fails QGP-G4I-DECISION because DEC-HAG-001 is open. Its missing handoff-header finding was corrected with the released evidence command; graph, scope, integrity, preflight and evidence predicates pass. This handoff is unfinished work and must not be treated as implementation completion or merge readiness. The decision-recording mismatch below remains unresolved.

After reviewing this exact handoff head, target branch and failed gate, mmzen explicitly authorized: "Publish the draft handoff with blockers disclosed". This publication transfers unfinished work to another agent. The failed gate remains failed; this authorization changes no lifecycle state and grants no verification acceptance, release, merge or merge-readiness decision.

## Validation and assurance boundary

- Three schemas: **60 checks passed** (37 accepted shapes, 23 rejected shapes), using disposable `jsonschema==4.26.0` and `python -I -B tests/hosted_artifact_graph/validate_wire_contracts.py`.
- Source suite: **1,284 tests, 22 reported skips, exit 0**, 188 classes / 8 workers, Windows Python 3.13.3 with process-local UTF-8 and default reduced scale: `python scripts/run_tests.py --workers 8`.
- `python scripts/validate_release_distributions.py --root .`: **PASS**, 22 distribution-bearing records. CLI help smoke check passed.
- Released validation: **1,933 artifacts, zero errors, 61 existing repository warnings**. Released doctor, selected review preflight and bounded Phase 1 scope checks passed.
- Reference context matches the original Git blob; canonical vectors, prior formal records and correction evidence remain unchanged.
- **Zero hosted service scenarios executed.** Memgraph schema execution, real HTTP/MCP/Cypher admission, transaction/concurrency tests, packaged walkthrough and restart/restore remain Phase 2 work. CI on this new PR is a separate observation and is pending at publication.

VREC-HAG-001 is verified by mmzen and applies to the evaluator correction candidate `169430fe25d28972a9b86fef2d00eccde2baa5db`, not this full hosted implementation. Its tested/package source is `08694a22ed754474267b0da98a9514648068f5f9`. No new VREC or implementation-completion transition is claimed for WO-HAG-001.

## Dependencies and decisions to preserve

1. **Released admission support:** The correction is implemented, verified and merged, but SPEC-HAG-003 still pins released 0.22.0. The chosen `extend-evaluator` route requires release through the existing process and explicit adoption/amendment of the hosted evaluator identity before dependent admission implementation. Do not silently substitute the candidate or duplicate evaluator policy in the service.
2. **Decision-recording mismatch:** mmzen already chose `extend-evaluator`. DEC-HAG-001 remains open because the released command rejected actual actor `mmzen` with WEX201 against the blocked WO's legacy `engineering-owner` label. [Retained attempt](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/9b6a2c378c61ce3f35e4a70a960dd12406da5c7e/docs/engineering/hosted-artifact-graph/evidence/WO-HAG-001/correction-decision-attempt.json). This is a recording defect, not an unanswered user choice. Do not impersonate the owner label or manually add disposition/lifecycle fields.
3. **Cypher remains:** The user explicitly retained Cypher and deferred Memgraph-side read-only enforcement. RISK-HAG-001 remains raised. Preserve application grammar/view/budget/rollback controls; no authoritative pilot or untrusted-network exposure is authorized.
4. **Authority and delivery:** mmzen approved WO-HAG-001 and its governing package and authorized Phase 1 continuation; the current request authorizes publishing this handoff branch/PR. It does not supply verification, release, merge or deployment decisions. Reuse valid prior decisions, preserving their exact scope.

The original source/evidence archive and candidate packages were built locally. A different host can recreate inputs from the pinned Git commits and image/build recipe identities in retained evidence. Rebuild the correction only from its recorded tested source and compare the recorded package digests; do not treat a local machine path as a durable distribution URL.
